value.text: The shorter Greek text represented by Codex Vaticanus lacks verses 6–8 and 10 and places the material of verse 9 within verse 5. A published reconstruction of the fragmentary Hebrew manuscript 4Q71 supports this arrangement. Another ancient Hebrew manuscript, 4Q70, preserves part of verse 10; a form of this verse also appears in the margin of the Greek manuscript Codex Marchalianus. This translation retains the longer Hebrew form; which form is earlier remains unsettled.
